visualCharacteristics.purpose: static list of authored routes with live lowest fares
traits: three-column grid of compact route teasers at desktop
small square destination image with a plane badge
origin over destination, price label and bold price right-aligned

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value. Rows: Origin | FRA or Frankfurt (FRA) (omitted: locale home airport); Destinations | CHI, WAS, IST or Chicago (CHI), ... (names authored in brackets are shown as is; otherwise names come from the fare service; omitted: the service recommends destinations); Trip duration | 7; Cabin | E; Trip type | One way (omitted: round trip); Travel months | 1,2,3,10,11,12 (omitted: all twelve); Price label | Round trip from; Link | optional URL pattern with {origin}, {destination}, {duration}, {cabin} (a pattern without {origin}/{destination} is ignored; default: the locale's /book-and-manage/destination page); Conditions | title + text (a title alone gets the text of /service/api/catalogs/conditions). The section heading stays default content above the block. Fares: POST /service/api/lhg-fare-teaser/fareteaser/manual with exactly the live body (fareTeaserManualTravels, cabin, tripType, tripDuration, travelMonths), rounded up and shown with the answer's currency symbol like the live site; images from the live /content/dam/lh/images/offers/destination/{code}-square.jpg. UI strings: an authored row wins, then the live labels (/service/api/labels/fareteaserstatic), then built-in English/German defaults

usage: Seasonal deals sections on homepage and offers pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any curated route list with prices. Request builders and response mappers of the live API are in scripts/lh-api.js; the block reads its settings (readFareTeaserSettings), lists its requests (fareTeaserRequests) and loads them (loadFareTeaserData).
